caption: The drawing depicts three views of a cast iron toy stove rendered in thin, black lines on a light tan or beige background. At the top left is a top-down view showing a circular stove with a scalloped edge on the inner rim and a central grate with five vertical bars, as well as two small circular lugs at opposite ends—possibly handles. Beneath this are two side views: the left view shows the stove’s main body as a rounded vessel standing on four short legs, with elongated, vertically oriented, oval cutouts around the body; an arched handle extends above the stove, attached at both sides. The right side view is similar but shown from a perpendicular angle, revealing a round finial or knob at the center of the handle attachment. At the bottom of the page, the object is identified as “TOY STOVE (CAST IRON)” in uppercase letters, with the name “philip johnson” appearing in small lowercase letters in the lower left corner. The composition is centered and minimally detailed, with no additional colors or shading.
title: Toy Stove
